sources.title: Data centre connection policy consultation
sources.limitations: Proposal only; current final-policy status requires follow-up. No site offer.

sources.title: Southern Finland connection capacity update
sources.limitations: Storage restrictions are distinct from consumption connections. No site offer.

sources.title: Proposed large data centre tariff
sources.limitations: Proposed CAD tariff; approval and actual connection conditions unverified.

sources.title: Data centres metered electricity consumption 2024
sources.limitations: Historical national consumption share, not facility count or latest-year assertion.

sources.title: Production of electricity and heat 2024
sources.limitations: Annual production; fossil-free includes nuclear and is not renewable-only or hourly supply.

sources.title: Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)
sources.limitations: Historical national output, not site supply or hourly carbon. CC BY 4.0 World Bank data terms; underlying IEA attribution.

sources.title: Research inventory
sources.limitations: Inventory for future demand research; no quantitative forecast taken from this site.

sources.title: DGX H100 specifications
sources.limitations: Reference class; 1.4 kW allocated system power and USD acquisition price are planning assumptions, not vendor quotes.

sources.title: Electricity supply emissions
sources.limitations: Source inventory only; numeric intensity awaits verification.

sources.title: Final electricity connection policy for data centres
sources.limitations: Final decision announcement; application-specific capacity, implementing process and site offer remain unverified.

sources.title: Large non-household electricity prices, 2025-S2
sources.limitations: Band IF: 70–150 GWh/year; national supplier averages, not regional offers. Baseline modeled consumption can exceed this band. Different tax categories require adjustment.

sources.title: Data centres move to electricity tax class I in July 2026
sources.limitations: Official Finnish guidance; no preferential data-centre class II assumed after July 2026.

sources.title: Electricity tax table effective April 2026
sources.limitations: Class I energy tax plus security fee; VAT excluded.

sources.title: Annual average exchange rates 2025
sources.limitations: 2025 annual averages held constant for screening; not October 2026 spot rates or currency forecasts. Derived EUR/USD cross-rate uses averages.

sources.title: Compute resource prices effective October 1, 2026
sources.limitations: H100 non-preemptible USD4.50/GPU-hour; CPU/RAM included in marketed HGX bundle. Storage and bulk capacity/commitment terms need quotes. Older marketing and introductory prices not used.

sources.title: Public cloud regions
sources.limitations: eu-north1 is Finland; no allocation or cluster reservation promised.

sources.title: Canada Central EC2 public price list, Linux p5.48xlarge
sources.limitations: Used/Shared/Linux/NA OnDemand only; USD63.296 per 8-GPU instance-hour. Not zero-price reservation meter, spot, Windows or negotiated quote. No capacity guarantee.

sources.title: Retail price API: North Europe H100 offers
sources.limitations: Query and full response saved in research report; Linux NC40ads H100 non-spot price USD8.376/hour, effective May 2024 and still returned now. Price entry is not allocation availability.

sources.title: NCads H100 v5 hardware specifications
sources.limitations: Single H100 NVL 94GB differs from H100 SXM80GB/InfiniBand training cluster. One-for-one productive equivalence is an unvalidated model assumption.

sources.title: Azure region locations
sources.limitations: North Europe is Ireland; region location alone does not prove H100 allocation.

sources.title: Electricity rates effective April 2026
sources.limitations: Rate LG CAD16.571/kW/month + CAD0.04324/kWh; monthly peak and minimum billing demand matter. New data-centre tariff proposal may replace this reference.

sources.title: Data-centre tariff proceeding R-4333-2026
sources.limitations: Proceeding includes revised proposals through August 2026. Final substantive tariff approval not verified; do not infer it from a procedural decision.

sources.title: August 2026 grid connection and balancing update
sources.limitations: New capacity almost fully reserved in many areas; regional waiting continues. Northern opportunities are not a Helsinki/Uusimaa offer.

sources.title: Cloud processing and controller obligations
sources.limitations: Controller/processor agreement and additional safeguards for non-EEA storage; institution-specific assessment remains necessary.

sources.publisher: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
sources.title: Privacy and outsourcing obligations
sources.limitations: Private-sector PIPEDA guidance; public universities may fall under provincial/public-sector laws. Does not establish a universal Canada-only storage requirement.

sources.title: Public cloud advertised H100 PCIe pricing
sources.limitations: CAD4.05 for h100-380, PCIe single GPU; storefront currency does not establish Québec availability, large-cluster fabric or workload equivalence. Excluded from baseline but retained as a cheaper quote candidate.

sources.title: Accelerated computing instance specifications
sources.limitations: p5.48xlarge has 8 H100 GPUs. Performance equivalence and availability still require workload validation.

sources.title: 2026 Global Data Center Outlook
sources.limitations: Page 25: forecast shell/core cost for 50MW air-cooled facility, excludes land and active IT; liquid cooling +10%. Applying global average to 20MW is a planning extrapolation, not a local quote.

sources.title: Eight-GPU HGX H100 server configurator
sources.limitations: Dynamic advertised configurations: Essential 319924, Professional 316184, Premium 333784 USD. Search cache differed from directly opened page; use direct current values. Tax, shipping, imports, bulk supply and shared fabric not priced.

sources.title: DGX H100 system datasheet
sources.limitations: Eight H100 GPUs and approximately 10.2kW maximum system draw; 1.275kW/GPU is a calculation, not workload productivity.

sources.title: Empirical Measurements of AI Training Power Demand on a GPU-Accelerated Node
sources.limitations: One-node study: idle 1.86kW; maximum measured 8.48kW, rated 10.2kW. Workload/configuration-specific; not a fleet power curve or provider performance comparison.

sources.title: EC2 billing by instance state
sources.limitations: Running instances are billed even when idle. Stopped compute is not billed; storage can remain charged. Reserved instances billed through term.

sources.title: VM states and billing
sources.limitations: Stopped allocated VM remains billed; deallocated compute is not billed. Other resources continue charges; reallocation availability not promised.

claims.text: No members have signed long-term computing commitments.
claims.rationale: Assignment starting fact; no signed demand dataset provided.
claims.uncertainty: Assignment starting fact; no signed demand dataset provided.

claims.text: Utility price, required upgrades and energization date are unknown.
claims.rationale: Utility offer required before investment approval.
claims.uncertainty: Utility offer required before investment approval.

claims.text: Baseline is 20 MW IT, PUE 1.25 and 25 MW facility load.
claims.rationale: Assignment baseline; PUE is not measured.
claims.uncertainty: Assignment baseline; PUE is not measured.

claims.text: Full-load annual energy is 219 GWh: 20 × 1.25 × 8760 / 1000.
claims.rationale: Nameplate energy, not modeled operating consumption.
claims.uncertainty: Nameplate energy, not modeled operating consumption.

claims.text: CRU published a proposed connection policy in February 2025, including location and generation considerations.
claims.rationale: Final-policy status remains unresolved; proposal is not enforced-rule proof.
claims.uncertainty: Final-policy status remains unresolved; proposal is not enforced-rule proof.

claims.text: Fingrid reported southern connection capacity constraints; storage restrictions extend to 2029, with consumption restrictions previously announced to early 2027.
claims.rationale: Check latest operator policy and individual site; storage capacity is not datacenter capacity.
claims.uncertainty: Check latest operator policy and individual site; storage capacity is not datacenter capacity.

claims.text: Hydro-Québec proposed a new tariff for data centres over 5 MW; projects remain subject to selection.
claims.rationale: Proposed average CAD 0.13/kWh subject to approval; not used as a confirmed delivered tariff.
claims.uncertainty: Proposed average CAD 0.13/kWh subject to approval; not used as a confirmed delivered tariff.

claims.text: Data centres represented 22% of metered electricity consumption in 2024.
claims.rationale: Historical national ecosystem measure; not comparable to a facility count.
claims.uncertainty: Historical national ecosystem measure; not comparable to a facility count.

claims.text: Statistics Finland reports 95% fossil-free electricity production in 2024.
claims.rationale: Annual domestic production; includes nuclear. No 24/7 matching claim.
claims.uncertainty: Annual domestic production; includes nuclear. No 24/7 matching claim.

claims.text: Demand forecast is 64,197,572.4 productive H100-equivalent GPU-hours per year.
claims.rationale: Derived once from baseline capacity: floor(18000/1.4) × 0.95 × 8760 × 0.60. Fixed across scale scenarios; uncommitted.
claims.uncertainty: Derived once from baseline capacity: floor(18000/1.4) × 0.95 × 8760 × 0.60. Fixed across scale scenarios; uncommitted.

claims.text: Costs are illustrative: facility USD 8m/MW; GPU USD 30k; lease USD 3/productive hour; delivered power IRL .15, FIN .10, CAN .10 USD/kWh.
claims.rationale: Constant 2026 USD; no utility/vendor quote or FX claim. These identical Canada/Finland values are assumptions, not country rankings.
claims.uncertainty: Constant 2026 USD; no utility/vendor quote or FX claim. These identical Canada/Finland values are assumptions, not country rankings.

claims.text: Hybrid owns 50% initially and expands at start of year 4, subject to grid availability.
claims.rationale: Fixed comparison schedule, not optimized.
claims.uncertainty: Fixed comparison schedule, not optimized.

claims.text: Reserve 20% of allocation for smaller institutions; teaching reservations, research quotas and overflow are proposed.
claims.rationale: No consortium agreement; independent board resolves conflicts and admits members.
claims.uncertainty: No consortium agreement; independent board resolves conflicts and admits members.

claims.text: Indicative research region: greater Dublin, chosen to investigate ecosystem and constrained-grid tradeoffs.
claims.rationale: No parcel selected; permits and utility offer unknown.
claims.uncertainty: No parcel selected; permits and utility offer unknown.

claims.text: Indicative research region: Helsinki/Uusimaa, chosen to investigate connectivity against southern-grid constraints.
claims.rationale: No claim of unconstrained capacity.
claims.uncertainty: No claim of unconstrained capacity.

claims.text: Indicative research region: Montréal/Québec, chosen to investigate provincial allocation and tariff conditions.
claims.rationale: Provincial evidence must not be generalized to Canada.
claims.uncertainty: Provincial evidence must not be generalized to Canada.

claims.text: Operating power uses 35% idle fraction, with 95% usable hours and 60% productive utilization.
claims.rationale: Coarse power curve, not telemetry; usable fraction applied once.
claims.uncertainty: Coarse power curve, not telemetry; usable fraction applied once.

claims.text: Equivalent leased throughput, egress, reservation guarantees and security remain unverified.
claims.rationale: Uniform H100 GPU-hour pricing does not prove workload equivalence.
claims.uncertainty: Uniform H100 GPU-hour pricing does not prove workload equivalence.

claims.text: No uptime guarantee: 48-hour critical operation requires fuel, cooling and network validation.
claims.rationale: UPS ride-through alone does not establish 48-hour availability.
claims.uncertainty: UPS ride-through alone does not establish 48-hour availability.

claims.text: CRU announced its final connection policy on 12 December 2025. New connections require local or onsite generation/storage matching maximum import demand, plus at least 80% annual demand from additional renewable projects in Ireland with a six-year glide path.
claims.rationale: Final announcement supersedes the February consultation status. These are policy conditions, not an approved project or capacity offer.
claims.uncertainty: Location constraints, implementing process and a project-specific connection offer remain unverified.

claims.text: Replace identical price placeholders with researched country/provider benchmarks and explicit conversions.
claims.rationale: Public GPU prices normalized to USD per billed GPU-hour; model uses 95% productive fraction plus 10% service allowance. Remaining ownership costs stay illustrative.
claims.uncertainty: Different suppliers and hardware mean this is screening, not an executable procurement comparison.

claims.text: Electricity input: 0.17240 EUR/kWh = 0.194650 USD/kWh; 2025-S2 Eurostat band IF, excluding VAT/recoverable taxes.
claims.rationale: 2025 BoC FX cross-rate held constant; no 2026 inflation escalation. Band IF may not match modeled consumption at every scale.
claims.uncertainty: National electricity proxy; H100 NVL94GB single GPU is not validated as SXM80GB/InfiniBand-equivalent. Storage/egress and cluster allocation unknown.

claims.text: Electricity input: 0.06485 EUR/kWh = 0.073220 USD/kWh; 2025-S2 Eurostat band IF ex-tax energy/network + 2026 class I tax/fee.
claims.rationale: 2025 BoC FX cross-rate held constant; no 2026 inflation escalation. Band IF may not match modeled consumption at every scale.
claims.uncertainty: National proxy with current data-centre tax adjustment, not a Uusimaa utility offer. Storage, quota and reservation terms unknown.

claims.text: Electricity input: 0.13000 CAD/kWh = 0.093003 USD/kWh; Hydro-Québec proposed average new >5MW data-centre rate; planning policy scenario.
claims.rationale: 2025 BoC FX cross-rate held constant; no 2026 inflation escalation. Band IF may not match modeled consumption at every scale.
claims.uncertainty: Proposed electricity rate not confirmed approved; LG demand-billed fallback shown separately. AWS regional public on-demand benchmark, not cheapest Canadian supplier or capacity offer.

claims.text: Published rental benchmark: Azure North Europe NC40ads H100 v5 at USD 8.376 per allocated GPU-hour.
claims.rationale: Non-spot/non-preemptible public price; per-GPU division where instance contains eight GPUs. Running-hour price is not productive-hour price.
claims.uncertainty: National electricity proxy; H100 NVL94GB single GPU is not validated as SXM80GB/InfiniBand-equivalent. Storage/egress and cluster allocation unknown.

claims.text: Published rental benchmark: Nebius eu-north1 H100 NVLink at USD 4.500 per allocated GPU-hour.
claims.rationale: Non-spot/non-preemptible public price; per-GPU division where instance contains eight GPUs. Running-hour price is not productive-hour price.
claims.uncertainty: National proxy with current data-centre tax adjustment, not a Uusimaa utility offer. Storage, quota and reservation terms unknown.

claims.text: Published rental benchmark: AWS Canada Central p5.48xlarge, 8 H100 GPUs at USD 7.912 per allocated GPU-hour.
claims.rationale: Non-spot/non-preemptible public price; per-GPU division where instance contains eight GPUs. Running-hour price is not productive-hour price.
claims.uncertainty: Proposed electricity rate not confirmed approved; LG demand-billed fallback shown separately. AWS regional public on-demand benchmark, not cheapest Canadian supplier or capacity offer.

claims.text: Data-centre electricity moves to class I from July 1, 2026; class I tax and security fee total 2.325 euro cents/kWh under the April 2026 table.
claims.rationale: Use ex-tax historical energy/network proxy plus current class I charges to avoid double-counting taxes.
claims.uncertainty: Future charges and utility supply price can change.

claims.text: August 2026 Fingrid update warns that additional connection capacity is almost fully reserved in many areas and regional waiting times continue.
claims.rationale: Updates the earlier 2025 southern-grid context; does not promise access in 2027.
claims.uncertainty: Site-specific utility diligence remains necessary.

claims.text: Rate LG currently lists CAD16.571/kW/month plus CAD0.04324/kWh; new large data-centre tariff proposal is a distinct policy scenario.
claims.rationale: At assumed 74% load factor, flat full-peak billing gives ~CAD0.073915/kWh before credits/taxes; this calculation is a reference, not an offer.
claims.uncertainty: Peak/minimum demand and tariff eligibility can materially change the bill.

claims.text: Cloud controllers must assess processor guarantees, use a written agreement and establish data handling locations; non-EEA storage needs additional safeguards.
claims.rationale: Apply to Irish member workload screening; avoid inferring an unrestricted cross-border consortium.
claims.uncertainty: Specific institutional policies and sensitive-data categories unknown.

claims.text: Canadian outsourcing privacy duties depend on the applicable legal regime; public-university provincial obligations need assessment.
claims.rationale: Federal private-sector PIPEDA guidance is not a universal university rule.
claims.uncertainty: Member institutions, data categories and provincial/public-sector requirements not supplied.

claims.text: Provider region and interconnect specifications are known; end-to-end member latency and workload equivalence remain unmeasured.
claims.rationale: Do not invent millisecond latency or a benchmark proving NVL/PCIe/SXM equivalence.
claims.uncertainty: Validate representative multi-node training and teaching/inference workloads before contracts.

claims.text: OVHcloud advertises CAD4.05/hour for a single H100 PCIe h100-380; Québec location and training-cluster equivalence are not established by the Canadian storefront.
claims.rationale: Retained as a lower-price procurement research candidate, not silently substituted for an 8-GPU H100 cluster benchmark.
claims.uncertainty: Could reverse country/strategy preference if suitable capacity and performance are proven.

claims.text: Facility construction basis is USD12.43 million per MW IT: global 2026 shell/core forecast USD11.3m/MW plus 10% liquid-cooling premium.
claims.rationale: Global proxy held equal across countries; analyst sensitivity ±20%. This range is a planning stress, not a published uncertainty interval.
claims.uncertainty: Scale, land, local supply chains and site-specific grid work remain unpriced.

claims.text: Owned GPU-server cost is USD39,990.50 per GPU-equivalent: advertised eight-H100 server USD319,924 divided by eight.
claims.rationale: Includes server CPU/RAM/baseboard; USD1.5m/MW separate allowance covers shared fabric/storage, excluding bundled host components. Model allocates cost per GPU, not an order for fractional servers.
claims.uncertainty: Observed configuration range USD39,523–41,723/GPU; import/tax/shipping/discounts and future replacement prices unknown.

claims.text: NVIDIA DGX H100 rated maximum 10.2kW across eight GPUs implies 1.275kW per GPU including node overhead.
claims.rationale: Retain conservative 1.4kW planning allocation; compare 1.275kW in robustness analysis with demand unchanged.
claims.uncertainty: DGX is a reference, not the Exxact server or leased performance guarantee.

claims.text: An empirical eight-H100 node study reports 1.86kW idle and 8.48kW maximum measured power.
claims.rationale: Idle/rated ratio approximately 18.2%; compare it with 35% planning idle fraction rather than treat one node as fleet telemetry.
claims.uncertainty: Power is not productive throughput; a multi-node workload benchmark remains missing.

claims.text: Compute billing follows allocated/running resources, not useful GPU work; stopped/deallocated treatment differs by provider.
claims.rationale: Pay-as-you-go savings require actually releasing compute; storage can remain billed and reserved commitments differ.
claims.uncertainty: Restart capacity, productive throughput, storage/egress costs and reservations need workload and contract evidence.

claims.text: Robustness tests vary ownership cost, productive conversion, idle power, refresh life and retained rental allocation.
claims.rationale: Published benchmarks anchor costs. ±20% construction, 70–100% productive conversion and retained-allocation billing are explicit analyst scenarios, not empirical distributions.
claims.uncertainty: No scenario probability or confidence percentage is inferred; an unchanged winner across tested cases is not investment approval.
